description: Click an element, by CSS selector or by an @eN ref from session_snapshot. Scrolls the element into view and dispatches a real mouse press and release at its centre, so handlers that ignore synthetic events still fire. Returns {clicked} naming what was targeted. Fails with 'Element not found' rather than clicking something else when nothing matches.

ref.description: A ref from session_snapshot, such as @e12, used instead of selector

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click

tabId.description: Tab to act on; uses the active tab when omitted

name: session_click
